verdict.rationale: Codegen provides a Python SDK and REST API to programmatically create/run/monitor agents, an explicit example of triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines on build failures, agent run logs/traces for debugging, and a CLI that supports non-interactive automation. This directly supports headless/CI usage beyond just interactive chat. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on CI pipeline example (e.g., a sample GitHub Actions workflow) or third-party confirmation that this works reliably outside vendor docs.
